title: feat(2d): rest machining on the 2D Pocket from the previous operations
body:
## What changed

The rest group of the 2D Pocket has a new mode, "previous operations".
In this mode the rest area is read from the stock that the earlier operations of the same setup leave.
The entered-tool mode of #1489 does not change, and it stays the default.

- `RestParams` has the field `source` (`RestSource::EnteredTool` or `RestSource::PreviousOperations`).
- `machining2d::rest_pocket_previous` plans the rest passes from a column grid.
  `rest_stock_from_columns` builds the `RestStock` of #2031 from that grid, one floor for each cut depth.
  `rest_plan_stock` makes the rest area from it.
- The grid is the one that `rest::prior_state` builds for the 3D Pocket: the setup stock, cut by the cached paths of the earlier operations, each with its tool shape.
- The reading is conservative:
  - A column stands at a cut depth when its top is above that depth. A floor allowance is material.
  - The standing columns grow by one cell diagonal.
  - A column that cannot be read stands. The pocket outside the grid stands.
  - The rest area is the union over all cut depths. A roughing pass that stops above the floor leaves the whole pocket.
- The two modes never use the planner of the other mode. Each planner refuses the other mode by name.
- The mode rides the existing `EditOperationParams` command (undo and redo), the project key `rest.source` and the MCP `edit_operation` parameter.
  A file without the key reads as the entered tool.
- The Pocket page has the row "Rest stock from". The previous tool rows hide in the new mode.

Generation refuses by name when the stock cannot be established:

- an earlier operation of the setup has no toolpath;
- an earlier operation of the setup has a stale toolpath;
- an earlier operation of the setup is suppressed and has a cut on record;
- the Pocket is tilted (also refused at the edit).

When no earlier operation cut, the stock is known. The whole pocket is cut and a note says it.

## Cause

The rest generator trusted the entered previous tool.
It could not see the depth that the earlier operation reached (#1490, item 3).

## Tests

Pins, all new:

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/rest_prior_tests.rs` (lib): `each_reading_guard_is_pinned_and_its_removal_fails_the_pin`, `a_floor_cut_at_the_cut_depth_does_not_stand_and_one_above_it_does`, `bad_input_is_refused_by_name`.
- `crates/motion/tests/rest_previous.rs`: 6 tests. They compare the rest area with an independent simulation of the earlier operations: a flat tool, a wall allowance, a bull-nose tool, mixed tools with a partial depth and disconnected cuts, an island. The rest path cuts each column that was left and cuts no wall.
- `crates/app/tests/rest_previous_ops.rs`: 7 tests. The real job against an independent simulation; the shallow roughing pass; the four refusals; stale after a changed tool, depth and order; `RegenerateAll`; undo and redo; the project file; MCP with save and reopen.
- `crates/app/src/operation/rest_op_tests.rs`: `the_rest_group_moves_the_stamp` now also covers the mode.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/rest_source_tests.rs`: 2 tests for the new row.

Red before the change: the pins use the new API and do not compile on `upstream/main`. Thus the mutation results below are the proof for each guard.

Mutations (one guard removed, its pin run, then restored):

| Guard removed | Pin | Mutant | Restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| every cut depth is read (`Guards::depth`) | `each_reading_guard_...` | red | green |
| an unreadable column stands (`Guards::unknown`) | `each_reading_guard_...` | red | green |
| the pocket outside the grid stands (`Guards::outside`) | `each_reading_guard_...` | red | green |
| one cell of growth (`Guards::cell`) | `each_reading_guard_...` | red | green |
| `rest_plan` refuses the new mode | `the_two_rest_modes_never_use_each_others_planner` | red | green |
| `rest_pocket_previous` refuses the entered mode | same | red | green |
| `validate` does not read the previous tool in the new mode | same | red | green |
| job: tilted plane refused | `a_tilted_plane_is_refused_by_name_at_the_edit_and_at_generation` | red | green |
| door: tilted plane refused at the edit | same | red | green |
| job: `previous_ops_refusal` is called | `a_stock_that_cannot_be_established_is_refused_by_name` | red | green |
| earlier operation suppressed | same | red | green |
| earlier operation stale | same | red | green |
| earlier operation never generated | same | red | green |
| the Pocket arm routes the mode | `the_rest_pass_cuts_what_the_simulated_roughing_pass_left` | red | green |
| stamp byte 0xD8 | `the_rest_group_moves_the_stamp` | red | green |

The first four guards have a switch in the code (`rest_prior::Guards`), and the unit test turns each off. The other eleven were removed by hand.

## Review evidence on the final head

The final head is `7969769d3f98555fab3448d5936214f91cb0736f`.
The review requests evidence only. The source and the head stay unchanged.

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` is green: 237 steps, 0 failed.
The selected lanes include every motion and app heavy target.
They ran 57 motion tests and 43 app tests. Six expected-failure probes gave the expected result.
The base is `upstream/main` at `60cb97a0b3717bf6a129e781fd8f4ec98806124b`.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is red: 385 steps, 1 failed, 39.8 minutes.

Six `egui_app::report_tests` tests and `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` could not create a graphics adapter.

`cargo clippy -j 4 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

These images use the existing Pocket page test fixture.
The GPU adapter was unavailable: `CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")`.

It did not recreate the controls or their text.

Before: the renderer from `upstream/main` at `60cb97a0b` uses the PR data model.

The source selector is absent. The three previous-tool rows are present.

![Before: previous-tool rows without the source selector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ffe6b26635486bf0f5cfd5a938b6eb01d972cd51/pr-2822/before.png)

![After: previous-operations mode hides the previous-tool rows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/ffe6b26635486bf0f5cfd5a938b6eb01d972cd51/pr-2822/after-previous-operations.png)

The pin is `egui_app::rest_pocket_tests::source::the_source_row_switches_the_mode_hides_the_tool_rows_and_commits_on_apply`.
The pin failed when the entered-tool visibility guard was disabled.
It passed after the guard was restored.


## Goldens moved

None. `git diff --stat upstream/main -- "*.nc" "*.cl" "*.png"` is empty.

## Not exercised

- A setup whose stock is carried from an earlier setup (#318). The code path is `rest::prior_state`, which the 3D Pocket uses. No test here crosses a setup boundary. The check for stale operations reads the same setup only.
- A WCS yaw. The existing `wcs_yaw::enter` turns the grid. No test here has a yaw.
- The field stock engine (#586, #637). The reader is `Columns`, which reads the two engines. The tests use the column grid.
- Zigzag and Offset rings in the new mode. They use the passes of the entered-tool mode, which has its own tests. The new tests use Waterline.
- The pixel snapshots (release lane). The new row moves the rows of a Pocket page that has rest machining on.
- The app was not started by hand. The UI tests ran the page in the test harness.

## Known limits (recorded in `docs/decisions/2033-rest-previous-ops.md`)

- One rest area for all levels. An upper level can cut air where only a lower level has material.
- The strict reading keeps a band of about 1.5 cells along each wall that an earlier tool rode. The rest pass follows those walls.
- The Adaptive strategy stays refused. The Adaptive strategy of the 2D Pocket is retired, so `rest_adaptive` has no door from this operation.
- The MCP skill text (`.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`) does not describe the new `source` key. The session could not write that file. That edit is owed.
- The guide pages on the site do not describe the new mode.

## Overlaps

- #2716 changes `generate.rs`, `job.rs` and `params.rs` in other arms (the Contour kind). Different function parts. The PR that merges second refreshes.
- #2714 changes `generate.rs`, `params.rs` and `machining2d/mod.rs` for the Slot Undercut kind. Different lines. The PR that merges second refreshes.
